_sagegui.name: TMT 11-plex
_sagegui.description: Typical TMT search from Michael Lazear. Static TMT (229.16293 -- TMT 6/10/11-plex, NOT TMTpro 304.2) on lysine and the peptide N-terminus, on top of carbamidomethyl C. The 0.4 Da fragment tolerance suits an ion-trap MS2; tighten to ~20 ppm for a high-resolution MS2. Both tolerance windows are symmetric. NOTE: TMT has never been tested end-to-end in SageGUI -- LFQ is the only validated path.
